billing.payAsYouGo: No separate relay usage charge. Beebo Relay plans are planned and are not available to buy yet.
billing.prepaid: No separate Beebo Relay top-up is required.

beeboRelay.balancePolicy: Separate Beebo Relay usage billing and top-ups are disabled.

ads.note: No ad-supported relay plan is offered.

notes.about: Shared public pricing configuration. Plan prices use subscriptionCurrency (CAD). The legacy currency field remains USD for vendor and historical relay-rate fields.
notes.version: Version 4. Beebo Relay plans are PLANNED and not available to buy yet. The flat fields (subscriptionMonthly, subscriptionCurrency, householdMaxMembers) describe tier 1 for any older client that only reads the flat fields. Older clients must not infer a paid or active subscription from this file.
notes.tiers: Planned optional Beebo Relay plans, in Canadian dollars per month: a free plan after the first month (1 away-from-home stream at a time, up to 480p), Tier 1 (2 away-from-home users at the same time) and Tier 2 (4 away-from-home users at the same time). The quality of the paid tiers is not decided, so no maxAwayQuality is given for them. Direct, UPnP and own-relay connections are free and are not limited by any plan.
notes.firstMonth: Planned and opt-in: turning Relay on gives Tier 1 for 30 days with no card and no charge, then the account moves to the free plan. Not active yet.
notes.status: free means nothing is charged for Beebo Relay today. It does not mean any plan is active or available to buy.
notes.freeAtThisTime: Compatibility flag: no separate relay usage billing and no paid plan is on sale.
notes.subscriptionMonthly: CA$3 per month: the planned price of tier 1. Compatibility field.
notes.subscriptionCurrency: CAD. Applies to subscriptionMonthly and tiers[].monthly. Vendor prices keep their own stated currency.
notes.householdMaxMembers: Six profiles in a household, including the owner. This is a profile count and is separate from how many people can watch through Beebo Relay at the same time.
notes.includedWithSubscription: False: no subscription is on sale, so nothing is included with one.
notes.beeboRelay.costPerGB: Legacy customer-charge field is zero because separate relay usage billing is disabled. This is not Beebo’s infrastructure cost.
notes.beeboRelay.topUp: Disabled. No separate Beebo Relay balance top-up is required.
notes.cloudflare: Optional customer-owned Cloudflare service; Cloudflare bills separately under its own terms. Legacy USD estimates retain their checked date and are not a Beebo charge.
notes.estimates.gbPerHour: Rough data estimates only, not a promised service allowance or a video-quality subscription tier.
notes.ads: Disabled. No advertising credit or ad-funded relay offer is announced.
